about_pullquote: I do the job right because my name's on it.
about_para_1: Ian Hayes has been painting and decorating across Manchester for over 20 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown through reputation and word-of-mouth — Ian still oversees every project personally. He's built his business on honesty, reliability, and the belief that preparation and quality materials matter more than cutting corners.
about_para_2: Customers return to Ian because he listens, gives straight advice, and delivers on time. He's equally at home refreshing a Victorian terraced house as he is transforming a modern apartment. That consistency and attention to detail is why he's trusted across Droylsden, Ashton, and beyond.

reviews.text: Had Ian in to repaint the front room and hallway. Really tidy worker, moved furniture carefully and cleaned up every day. The finish is brilliant — crisp lines, no drips, exactly what we wanted. Fair price too. Will definitely have him back for the bedroom.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior woodwork done before winter. Ian came, gave a clear quote with no surprises, and finished on schedule. Looks professional and you can tell he's used proper materials. Top lad, reliable, and does what he says he'll do.
reviews.author: Sandra K.

reviews.text: Struggled to find someone willing to tackle the wallpaper in our older property — lots of uneven walls. Ian sorted it without a fuss, matched the pattern perfectly, and the room looks stunning now. Highly recommend if you want someone who actually knows his craft.
reviews.author: David P.
